map.根据车型、载重与季节推荐前后轮标准胎压，提示冷胎与热胎读数差异及充气注意事项，帮: Recommends standard front and rear tire pressures from vehicle type, load and season, explains cold vs hot readings and inflation precautions, helping extend tire life and keep driving safe.
map.停车 3 小时以上或行驶不足 2 km 时读数才对应标准值: Only a reading after 3+ hours parked or less than 2 km driven corresponds to the standard value
map.同轴左右差应 ≤ 0.1 bar，偏差大先查慢漏或胎压表误差: Left-right difference on the same axle should be ≤ 0.1 bar; a larger gap means a slow leak or gauge error
map.以驾驶员侧门框标贴或油箱盖内侧标注值为准: Follow the driver-side door-jamb label or the figure inside the fuel filler flap
map.充气或换位后按车型说明完成系统复位/标定: After inflating or rotating, reset or recalibrate the system following the vehicle instructions
map.行驶后胎温上升会使胎压虚高，通常升 10 ℃ 约增 0.07~0.1 bar。热: Driving raises tire temperature and inflates the reading, usually by 0.07~0.1 bar per 10 °C. A high hot reading is normal, so never bleed air hot, or it will be under-inflated once cooled and trigger the warning.
map.多数车型在胎压低于推荐值约 25% 时点亮报警，部分车型按 25% 或 0.5: Most vehicles light the warning near 25% below the recommended value, some taking whichever is smaller between 25% and 0.5 bar. Check promptly rather than merely resetting; driving under-inflated makes the sidewalls flex and overheat, and can cause a blowout.
map.💡 备胎同样需要检查：多数备胎标准压力高于在用胎（常见 3.0~4.2 bar）: 💡 Check the spare too: most spares run higher than road tires (commonly 3.0~4.2 bar), and neglecting them means they fail when you need them.

map.按车型门框标贴的标准胎压核对实测值，判断前/后轮是否需要补气或放气。: Check measured pressures against the standard values on the door-jamb label to decide whether front or rear tires need air or bleeding.
map.季节交替或长途满载前重新核算推荐胎压，避免热胎虚高误判与高温爆胎风险。: Recompute recommended pressure after a season change or before a long fully loaded trip, avoiding wrong calls from hot-tire readings and high-temperature blowout risk.
map.TPMS 报警灯亮起时先按理想气体折算排除温度因素，再判断是慢漏还是系统误报。: When the TPMS lamp comes on, first convert using the ideal gas law to exclude temperature, then decide between a slow leak and a false alarm.
map.轿车胎压折算与报警下限: Converting pressure and warning threshold for a sedan
map.轿车基准前 2.3 / 后 2.3 bar，空载常温下推荐值即 2.3 bar。: A sedan with baseline front 2.3 / rear 2.3 bar recommends 2.3 bar unladen at normal temperature. Measuring 2.3 bar front and rear at 25 °C converts to 2.26 bar at the 20 °C reference, a −0.04 bar deviation inside the ±0.15 bar tolerance, so it passes. With a 25% warning ratio the TPMS threshold is 2.3 × 0.75 = 1.73 bar; fully loaded the recommendation rises to front 2.5 / rear 2.6 bar and the thresholds to 1.88 / 1.95 bar.
map.热胎读数偏高要不要放气？: The hot reading is high - should I release air?
map.不要。行驶后胎温上升会使胎压虚高，通常升 10 ℃ 约增 0.07~0.1 ba: No. Driving raises tire temperature and the apparent pressure by about 0.07~0.1 bar per 10 °C, which is normal. Releasing air hot leaves it under-inflated once cooled and triggers the warning. Wait for a cold reading (parked over 3 hours or driven under 2 km), or convert the hot reading to the reference temperature as this page does before comparing.
map.TPMS 报警后可以直接复位吗？: Can I just reset TPMS after the warning?
map.不建议。报警代表胎压已低于推荐值约 25%，应先检查四轮实际胎压并找出亏气原因（: Not recommended. The warning means pressure is already about 25% below recommendation; inspect all four tires first and find the cause (nail, leaking valve core, sidewall damage). Resetting alone hides the real leak, and driving under-inflated overheats the sidewalls with blowout risk. After inflating or rotating, reset following the vehicle instructions.
map.夏天要不要把胎压调低一些？: Should I lower tire pressure in summer?
map.不必刻意调低。胎压应始终按门框标贴的冷态标准值充注，高温行驶带来的升压已由设计余: No need. Always inflate to the cold standard value on the door-jamb label; the rise from hot driving is already covered by design margin. The real trap is releasing air hot, which pushes cold pressure below spec. The seasonal correction here applies to computing the target value and is about ±0.1 bar.
map.胎压须在冷胎状态测量，TPMS 报警后应先查因再复位: Measure pressure cold; after a TPMS warning find the cause before resetting
